summary: Isolate governance preflight cache test checkout

delivery.outcome: Run unchanged cache/output regressions in a private nested checkout with controls inside owner cache and outside the tested checkout. Preserve source Git configuration and execute current working CLI implementations.
nonGoals: No production path, approval or snapshot trust changes
No runtime deployment, release grant, tag/Release or adopter effect
No legacy metadata movement or foreign worktree mutation

architecture.decision: Single test module owns a clean no-hardlinks Git fixture pinned to actual source HEAD and fetched origin/main. Parent-scoped temporary controls remain inside canonical owner cache and outside fixture; hooks and teardown mutate only fixture config. Current working checker and bundled script are executed against that fixture. Symlink cache refusal and module cleanup preserve owner boundary.
architecture.rollback: Revert reviewed test-only change through protected source publication.

validation.evidence: All five existing tests under protected publisher environment, read-only actual source/config with own cache writable; output negative cases unchanged.

commands: Independent exact-head hosted checks and Validator review/merge
validation.evidence: One implementation test file; no production or managed package changes; genuine external fencing before source writer.
